title: Logistics: Troubleshooting
summary: Diagnose common Logistics failures by shrinking the loop and testing one fix.

blocks.title: Common Failure
blocks.body: If a request fails, check the bound target, network id, loadout id, stock rows, and whether the target block is still loaded and powered.

blocks.title: Reset The Loop
blocks.body: If a request fails, check the target, network, labels, stock, power, loaded area, and whether the requested loadout names items the system can see.

blocks.title: One Fix At A Time
blocks.body: Change one variable, run a smaller test, and compare the result. Fixing three things at once can hide the part that actually mattered.

blocks.title: Retest Cleanly
blocks.body: Change one variable, test on a smaller route, and keep the fix only if the failure becomes easier to explain.
